description: Management is unaware of the program or does not acknowledge it as a formal initiative.
Management tolerates the program informally but provides no budget, time allocation, or public backing.
Management has formally acknowledged the program's existence and purpose, though support is inconsistent.
Management actively sponsors the program with allocated budget and time, and communicates its importance to the organization.
The program has strong, visible executive sponsorship, dedicated budget, and is treated as a strategic priority referenced in leadership communications.
